player_prompt.intro:
Ati Countdown lakkoofsii taphatte! 
Ajjeecha: Lakkoofsii waliin wajjin +, -, *, / fayyadamuu, target ni dhufu. 
Galeessaa haaraa: [i j op], jechuun i,j lakkoofsa fi op waliin operation. 
Misaala: [0 2 *] lakkoofsi 0 waliin lakkoofsi 2 wajjin ykn waliin wajjin mara.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Invalid action format. Use `[i j op]` where i,j are indices and op is +,-,*,/
invalid_move.invalid_indices: Indices invalid. must be different and in range 0-{max_index} (Indeeksii hin ta'u, gosa adda addaa fi giddu galeessa keessatti kan argamu)
invalid_move.invalid_operation: Invalid operation (division by zero or non-integer result)

outcome.turn_limit: Xumura geessisuu ni cufti. Ilmiin guutuu: {best_value} (target: {target})
